test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II ( JSO ) 2021 Official Paper ( Held On: 10 August 2022 )
subject: general
question: Which one is not basis of classification of data?
solution:
The correct answer is **Geological classification**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The basis of classification of data can be broadly categorized into four categories, namely, geographical, temporal, qualitative, and quantitative classification.
 
• **Geological classification **is not one of the commonly used basis of data classification.
 
• **Geographical classification** is based on location or region.
 
• **Temporal classification** is based on time or date.
 
• **Qualitative classification** is based on non-numeric attributes such as color, shape, and size.
 
• **Quantitative classification** is based on numeric attributes such as height, weight, and temperature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The basis of classification of data is an important aspect of data analysis and helps in organizing and summarizing data.
 
• The choice of the basis of classification depends on the type of data and the objective of the analysis.
 
 
• For example, if the objective is to analyze the sales of a company based on different regions, then geographical classification would be an appropriate basis.
 
 
 
• The basis of classification should be chosen based on the type of data and the objective of the analysis.
 
• A clear and appropriate basis of classification can make the data analysis process easier and more effective.
